mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1250 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1250.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST > 1250.0 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, strong demand indicators like retail sales (RSAFS) signal overheating, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods despite high RSAFS, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment growth signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 4.5 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL rising fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve typically implements monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 5.0 is below 0.03.
